title: Hold a tobacco retail licence
what: Carry on the business of selling tobacco products by retail only under a retail licence.

sources.title: Tobacco and E-Cigarette Products Act 1997 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) carry on the business of selling tobacco products by retail; or (b) hold themself out as carrying on such a business, unless the person holds a retail licence
